description: Google Apps Script API - Programmatically manage Apps Script projects (read code, execute functions, debug errors, manage deployments). Apps Script extends Google Workspace with JavaScript automation. These tools enable reading script source code, diagnosing execution failures, modifying implementations, running functions remotely, and managing versions/deployments - essential for automated debugging and self-healing script maintenance.

tools.name: google_apps_script_list_projects
tools.short_description: List all Apps Script projects with script IDs, titles, and parent container metadata
tools.description:
List all Apps Script projects accessible to authenticated user. Returns script IDs, titles, parent containers (if bound to Sheets/Docs), and timestamps. Use this as the first step to discover available scripts before performing operations. Supports pagination for users with many projects.

Use when: User asks 'What scripts do I have?', finding script by name, building script inventory, starting debugging workflow.

Returns: Array of {scriptId, title, parentId, createTime, updateTime} with pagination support.

page_size.description: Projects per page (1-100, default 50). Larger sizes reduce API calls.

page_token.description: Pagination token from previous response. Use when has_more=true.

tools.name: google_apps_script_get_content
tools.short_description: Get complete source code, HTML files, and manifest from Apps Script project by ID
tools.description:
Get complete source code and files from Apps Script project. Returns all .gs files (JavaScript), .html files, and appsscript.json manifest. Essential for debugging - read actual code to understand functionality and identify bugs. Manifest shows OAuth scopes (critical for permission errors).

Use when: User says 'Why is script failing?', debugging errors, preparing to modify script, analyzing dependencies.

Returns: Array of files with {name, type, source} plus parsed manifest with oauthScopes.

script_id.description: Unique script project ID from list_projects. Format: 20-char alphanumeric.

version_number.description: Specific version (optional). null = HEAD (latest). Use for historical versions.

tools.name: google_apps_script_update_content
tools.short_description: Update Apps Script source code files, HTML templates, or manifest configuration
tools.description:
Update script source code. Modifies .gs files, .html files, or manifest. Use to fix bugs, add features, update OAuth scopes, or refactor code. Always call get_content first to read current code before updating.

Use when: Fixing script bugs, adding features, updating OAuth scopes, refactoring code.

Returns: Updated project with new content.

files.description: Array of file objects with {name, type, source}. Include ALL files (unchanged + modified).

conversation_memory_hints.search_context: When user asks about recent updates

tools.name: google_apps_script_run_function
tools.short_description: Execute Apps Script function remotely by name with parameters and return value
tools.description:
Execute a function in Apps Script project remotely. Runs specified function with parameters and returns result. Requires script deployed as API executable. Use to test fixes, trigger automation, or extract data programmatically. Max execution: 6 minutes.

Use when: Testing after code changes, running automation on demand, extracting data.

Returns: Function result (strings, numbers, arrays, objects only - no Apps Script objects).

parameters.description: Function parameters (optional). Basic types only: string, number, boolean, array, object.

dev_mode.description: Run latest saved code (true) or deployed version (false). Only owner can use dev_mode.

workflow: Ensure script deployed as API executable
best_practices: Check OAuth scopes cover all needs

tools.name: google_apps_script_list_processes
tools.short_description: List recent Apps Script execution processes with status, duration, and error logs
tools.description:
List execution history for user's Apps Scripts. Shows recent function executions, status (SUCCESS/FAILED), duration, error messages, and timestamps. Essential for debugging - see what failed and when. Filter by script or view all.

Use when: User reports 'script is failing', investigating error patterns, monitoring execution health.

Returns: Array of {processId, scriptId, functionName, status, duration, startTime, error}.

script_id.description: Filter by specific script (optional). Omit to see all scripts.

tools.name: google_apps_script_create_deployment
tools.short_description: Create new Apps Script deployment with version and access configuration for production
tools.description:
Deploy Apps Script project as API executable or web app. Creates new deployment with version and access controls. Required for run_function to work. Configure who can access (owner only, domain, anyone).

Use when: Making script executable via API, deploying web app, setting up automation.

Returns: Deployment ID and URL.

version_number.description: Version to deploy. Use create_version first or omit for HEAD.

tools.name: google_apps_script_create_version
tools.short_description: Save current Apps Script code as versioned snapshot with description for rollback
tools.description:
Create immutable snapshot of script project. Captures current code state with version number. Use before deploying to production or when creating stable releases. Versions cannot be modified (guarantees stability).

Use when: Creating stable release, before production deployment, milestone checkpoints.

Returns: Version number and metadata.

tools.name: google_apps_script_list_versions
tools.short_description: List all saved Apps Script versions with version numbers, descriptions, and timestamps
tools.description:
List all versions of script project. Shows version numbers, creation dates, and descriptions. Use to see version history, find versions to deploy, or identify when code changed.

Use when: Finding version to deploy, viewing history, identifying when changes occurred.

Returns: Array of {versionNumber, createTime, description}.

workflow: Select version for get_content or deployment
best_practices: Use with get_content to compare versions

tools.name: google_apps_script_get_metrics
tools.short_description: Get Apps Script execution metrics with performance data, quota usage, and error rates
tools.description:
Get usage metrics for script project. Shows execution counts, active users, failure rates over time periods (7 days, 30 days). Use for monitoring script health and usage patterns.

Use when: Monitoring script usage, analyzing failure patterns, capacity planning.

Returns: Metrics with {totalExecutions, failedExecutions, activeUsers, executionsByDay}.

tools.name: google_apps_script_analyze_errors
tools.short_description: Analyze Apps Script execution errors with stack traces, patterns, and diagnostic suggestions
tools.description:
SMART TOOL: Analyze execution errors from process logs. Parses error messages, identifies common patterns (permission errors, quota exceeded, deprecated APIs), extracts actionable insights, and suggests fixes. Aggregates multiple errors to find root causes.

Use when: Multiple script failures, recurring errors, need diagnostic summary.

Returns: {errorPatterns, rootCauses, suggestedFixes, affectedFunctions}.

processes.description: Array of process objects from list_processes (FAILED status)

rootCauses: Missing Drive API scope in manifest

error_handling: Empty processes: No errors to analyze

tools.name: google_apps_script_debug_script
tools.short_description: Debug Apps Script by analyzing code, execution logs, and error patterns with AI insights
tools.description:
SMART TOOL: Complete debugging workflow. Combines multiple operations: list projects (find script), get content (read code), list processes (get errors), analyze errors (diagnose), suggest fixes. Returns comprehensive diagnostic report with code snippets, error analysis, and action plan.

Use when: User says 'fix my script', comprehensive debugging needed, first-time troubleshooting.

Returns: {scriptInfo, codeAnalysis, errorSummary, diagnosticReport, recommendedActions}.

script_id.description: Script ID (optional). If omitted, searches by script_name.

script_name.description: Script name to search for (optional). Used if script_id not provided.

include_code_review.description: Include code quality analysis (deprecated APIs, missing error handling)

expected_result.diagnosticReport: Found 12 failures in last 7 days. Root cause: Missing Drive API scope.

workflow: Call debug_script with name or ID
error_handling: Script not found: Check name spelling
No errors: Check if script executed recently

tools.name: google_apps_script_fix_common_issues
tools.short_description: Automatically fix common Apps Script issues like permissions, quotas, and deprecated APIs
tools.description:
SMART TOOL: Auto-fix common script issues. Detects and repairs: missing OAuth scopes, deprecated API calls, missing error handling, hardcoded credentials. Generates updated code with fixes applied. Returns before/after comparison and explanation of changes.

Use when: Common error patterns detected, user wants automatic fixes, after error analysis.

Returns: {fixesApplied, updatedFiles, changesSummary, requiresManualReview}.

fix_types.description: Types of fixes to apply: oauth_scopes, deprecated_apis, error_handling, hardcoded_credentials

auto_apply.description: Automatically apply fixes (true) or return for review (false)

expected_result.changesSummary: Added 1 missing OAuth scope to manifest

error_handling: No issues found: Script may be correct

tools.name: google_apps_script_backup_project
tools.short_description: Create complete backup of Apps Script project with code, files, and manifest for recovery
tools.description:
SMART TOOL: Export complete script project backup. Downloads all files (.gs, .html, manifest), creates JSON export with metadata (version history, deployments, recent executions). Use before major changes or for disaster recovery.

Use when: Before major changes, disaster recovery prep, migrating scripts.

Returns: {backupData, files, metadata, exportTimestamp}.

tools.name: google_apps_script_restore_version
tools.short_description: Restore Apps Script project to previous saved version by version number for rollback
tools.description:
SMART TOOL: Restore script to previous version. Combines get_content (for specified version) + update_content (to apply) + create_deployment (if needed). Use for rollback after bad deployment or recovering from broken changes.

Use when: Rollback needed, script broken after update, recover previous working state.

Returns: {restoredVersion, deploymentStatus, restorationSummary}.
